title: Credit Terms by Program — Bluegate Business Storage Account
content:
Invoice terms, credit limits, net-terms eligibility, credit limit review intervals and dispute windows of the **Bluegate Business Storage Account** are set per program as follows.

| Program | Invoice terms (calendar days after the invoice date) | Credit limit (largest unpaid invoice balance before new services stop) | Months of on-time payment before net terms are offered on review | Months between credit limit reviews | Days after the invoice date within which an invoice line may be disputed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Business Essentials | 0 (due on receipt) | $1500.00 | 6 | 12 | 30 |
| Bluegate Business Plus | 0 (due on receipt) | $2500.00 | 6 | 12 | 30 |
| Bluegate Business Pro | 15 | $5000.00 | 6 | 12 | 30 |
| Bluegate Business Logistics | 15 | $10000.00 | 6 | 6 | 45 |
| Bluegate Business Fleet | 15 | $10000.00 | 6 | 6 | 45 |
| Bluegate Business National Account | 30 | $50000.00 | 3 | 6 | 60 |

### Reading notes

1. **Invoice terms.** The figure is a number of calendar days after the invoice date by which the invoice must be paid. A figure of 0 means the invoice is due on receipt, on its invoice date.
2. **Credit limit.** The figure is the program's credit limit in US dollars: the largest unpaid invoice balance allowed before new services stop. It is the limit an approval sets for the program.
3. **Net terms.** Net terms longer than the program's own invoice terms are offered on review only after the number of months of on-time payment shown. National Account needs 3 months; every other program needs 6.
4. **Credit limit review.** The credit limit is reviewed at the interval shown: every 12 months on Essentials, Plus and Pro, every 6 months on Logistics, Fleet and National Account.
5. **Dispute window.** An invoice line may be disputed within the number of days of the invoice date shown: 30 on Essentials, Plus and Pro, 45 on Logistics and Fleet, 60 on National Account.

### Side-by-side comparisons (derived from the table)

- Logistics and Fleet carry identical credit terms in every column.
- Essentials and Plus differ only in credit limit ($1500.00 against $2500.00).
- Pro and Logistics share 15-day terms but differ in credit limit ($5000.00 against $10000.00), review interval (12 months against 6) and dispute window (30 days against 45).
